component.name: MiniSnap
component.summary: Capture, annotate and record your screen
Chụp, chú thích và quay màn hình

description.p: MiniSnap is free, open-source screenshot and screen recording software for everyone. Capture a region, a window or the whole screen, annotate it and share it in seconds.

ul.li: Capture a region, a window or the full screen, with a magnifier and exact pixel sizes
After selecting an area, choose a screenshot, a video or a scrolling capture
Scrolling capture of long pages, with sticky headers and footers handled
Annotate with arrows, boxes, ellipses, lines, a pen, highlights, text, blur and step numbers
Every capture is saved to Pictures/MiniSnap and copied to the clipboard
Record the screen or a region to MP4
Extract text from images (OCR) with Tesseract, including Vietnamese
A library of your images and videos with thumbnails
Global keyboard shortcuts on desktops that support them
Vietnamese and English interface; works on Wayland and X11 through xdg-desktop-portal

description.p: MiniSnap collects no data. Screen access always goes through the system's permission prompts.

screenshot.caption: Annotate a capture with arrows, boxes, text, blur and step numbers
Start a capture, a recording or text extraction from the launcher

description.p: Update MiniSnap from the app: the .deb version downloads the new package, checks its SHA-256 digest and installs it after asking for your password; every version also shows the Terminal command that updates it.

Screenshots on GNOME (Ubuntu 24.04) no longer fail with "response 2": MiniSnap identifies itself to the portal, falls back to the system screenshot tool when a silent capture is refused, and can ask for the screenshot permission again.
Scrolling capture of long pages, global keyboard shortcuts on desktops that support the GlobalShortcuts portal, and a Flatpak build without network access.
First Linux version: region, window and full-screen capture through xdg-desktop-portal, annotation editor, screen recording, text extraction and the image and video library.
